  <RD format_version="4">
    <description>
      C. P. Schenk, A. W. Liehr, M. Bode, and H.-G. Purwins
(1999) "Quasi-Particles in a Three-Dimensional Three-Component Reaction-Diffusion System"
High Performance Computing in Science and Engineering, pp. 354-364. 
<a href="http://www.uni-muenster.de/Physik.AP/Purwins/RD/Literatur/hlrs1999.pdf">[PDF]</a>

Dissipative solitons in a three-chemical system, by the Purwins group at 
Munster. <a href="http://www.uni-muenster.de/Physik.AP/Purwins/Gruppe/Purwins-en.html">[link]</a>
    </description>
    <rule name="Schenk" type="formula" wrap="1" neighborhood_type="vertex" neighborhood_range="1" neighborhood_weight="laplacian">
      <param name="D_a">
        0.00015
      </param>
      <param name="D_b">
        0.00015
      </param>
      <param name="D_c">
        0.0096
      </param>
      <param name="k3">
        8.5
      </param>
      <param name="lambda">
        2
      </param>
      <param name="k1">
        -6.92
      </param>
      <param name="theta">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="tau">
        48
      </param>
      <param name="dx">
        0.0072
      </param>
      <param name="timestep">
        0.002
      </param>
      <param name="pk">
        0.99999
      </param>
      <param name="fb">
        0.2
      </param>
      <formula number_of_chemicals="6">
        delta_a = fb * f + D_a * laplacian_a / (dx*dx) - b - k3*c + lambda*a - a*a*a + k1;
delta_b = ( D_b * laplacian_b / (dx*dx) + a - b ) / tau;
delta_c = ( D_c * laplacian_c / (dx*dx) + a - c ) / theta;
float4 w = laplacian_b * laplacian_c;
d = pk * d + (1 - pk) * w;
e = pk * e + (1 - pk) * (w - d) * (w - d);
f = (w - d)/sqrt(e);
      </formula>
      
    </rule>
